axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.rationale: All material brief obligations and negative constraints are carried into the self-contained proposal.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.rationale: Consequential platform/storage facts match governing authorities with capability, metric, version and durability qualifications; minor historical issue context is recorded separately.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.rationale: Useful mechanisms include OS job/cgroup boundaries, high versus max, DRR as analogy, semaphore limits and WAL-reset history. Source-backed choices are separated from measured defaults.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.rationale: Product clauses are correctly retained, narrowed or amended; F01-F05 are all independently assessed and explicitly disposed. No criticism is falsely rejected.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.rationale: Supported queue, fairness alternatives, fencing, fallback, unknowns and validation status survive revision. Shutdown and the previously undefined barrier are improved; no material preservation loss found.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.rationale: Proposed race/crash/platform/load checks have relevant properties and measurements. No tests, workload or target deployment are represented as performed.

obligations.finding: Host owns durable state; active and waiting caps, verified identities and backpressure.
FIFO/priority/RR/DRR compared; fit and bypass barrier conditions and long-job limits are explicit.
Declarations, observed distributions, reservation heuristic, pressure, OS boundaries and counts are distinct.
Conditional platform boundaries, assignment/descendants, delegation, fallback and verified termination.
Durable cancel wins before publication, cooperative stop then owned escalation, stopped state differs from request.
Optional rate-limited structured progress, scoped queue position, concrete blocker and no invented ETA.
Generation/state CAS and host-record visibility; cancel-first and success-first ordering; no cross-resource atomicity claim.
Queued rows persist; reconcile old workers, fencing, idempotency/versioned checkpoints, no unsafe duplicate.
One-use promotion and optional capped pressure override; peer delay and failure/responsiveness consequences.
No count-as-memory, payment priority, elevation requirement, unrelated kill, full platform or deployment.
Values require measurement; phased integration and meaningful failure/load oracles are proposed, not executed.
